properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_redrawn_edge_keeps_what_the_call_leaves_out.rs, in the MCP crate's in_memory program, through draw_edges. For each of the 25 typed helpers whose edge declares a property: draw bare, plant a declared property the bare call does not name, draw bare again — the property survives. depends_on without argued_by keeps an earlier argument; a property the call names still overrides; and every helper draw_edges runs is a row or excluded with its reason (imposes, operates_in, performed_in, pin_at_epoch, precedes declare no property; move_component and contain_component move rather than re-draw).
properties.findings: 4 passed on branch fix/statuses-and-redraws-keep-what-was-given at 225b20d. OBSERVED FAILING FIRST on main 6a45d4b: 3 of 4 — 23 helpers dropped the planted property (all but satisfies and authored_by), depends_on without argued_by dropped the argument, and the override test failed with them; the table-completeness test passed.
properties.name: Every typed edge helper keeps what a redraw leaves out (4 MCP tests)
